bayts.text: And lead to the Effacer, by the right of adh-Dhāriyāt, the best glad tidings that endure growing.
And bless, O Truth (Al-Ḥaqq), by the right of aṭ-Ṭūr, him who came with the Inscribed (Qurʾān 52:2).
our master Muḥammad, and grant peace, and the Family and the Companions; and preserve my pen,
my body and all of me from all that You have not approved for me; and keep my family safe.
And bless, O Trustee (Al-Wakīl), with peace, him toward whom my pens tend,
for the mission and his being above all the creation of the Fashioner, to Whom belong the multitudes,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome,
by the sanctity of an-Najm and by the right of al-Qamar, O You Who lead to Yourself the best throngs.
And grant me, by the right of Your noble Countenance, through him, with You, glad tidings that do not depart.
And bless, O Strong (Al-Qawī), O Firm (Al-Matīn), him through whom the trials have been effaced,
without return to my side, forever, our master, he through whom appeared from You
a wise Remembrance that You led to us: and it is honoured with us.
our intercessor Muḥammad, and grant peace, with the Family and the Companions; and honour my pen.
And to the Prophet, by the sūra ar-Raḥmān, convey Your two greetings of peace with safety.
And bless, O Patron (Al-Walī), O Praiseworthy (Al-Ḥamīd), him to whom praise has yielded,
and that is the most excellent of creation, Muḥammad; and lead to him from my service what is praised,
in his Family and his Companions, and grant peace, and increase for him what gladdens him from my pen,
by the sanctity of al-Wāqiʿa, the venerated, and by the sanctity of al-Ḥadīd, possessed of might.
And bless, O Reckoner (Al-Muḥṣī), with a blessing surpassing every blessing, with a peace that rises,
upon the chosen Prophet, whose intercession is accepted, and the Family and the Companions; and raise my service
with a raising of acceptance, and efface what has issued from me outside the good pleasure of Him to Whom belongs the decree.
And keep my outward and my inward forever from clothing themselves in what is not praised.
Āmīn, O Lord, by the sanctity of the Disputation (sūra al-Mujādala) and by the sanctity of the Qurʾān; and spare me disputation.
And grant me, of what You have counted, what You chose for me, O You Who are pleased, Who have pleased.
And spare me what none but You can count of harm, and make my desire within Your desire (will).
Āmīn, O Originator (Al-Mubdiʾ), O Restorer (Al-Muʿīd), O You through Whom, from Him, to Him we return.
O You toward Whom my writing has turned, and my service with You has already been extolled before,
bless and grant peace forever upon the trustworthy, our master Muḥammad, he who does not lie,
his Family and his Companions; and grant me through him the righteousness of the righteous before me.
And make my compositions dearer to Allah than others, O Best King Who is loved.
And expand through them the breasts of those who learned, an expansion by which the darknesses leave them.
And bless, O Giver of Life (Al-Muḥyī), with a blessing with peace, him who came with the finest speech,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and the Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
by the sanctity of al-Ḥashr and by the right of al-Mumtaḥana, aṣ-Ṣaff and al-Jumuʿa, always, when (their time) comes.
And bless, O Living Who does not die, him through whom the Giver of Death (Al-Mumīt) gave me glad tidings,
our master Muḥammad, and grant peace, in the Family, the Companions and every Muslim.
And by al-Munāfiqūn and at-Taghābun turn harm toward other than what has been built for us.
And spare us what draws hypocrisy, and grant us good pleasure with concord.
O Living, O Self-Subsisting, bless forever and grant peace upon him whose grace has appeared,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome,
By the sūra aṭ-Ṭalāq and at-Taḥrīm increase the Prophet in the highest honour.
By the sūra al-Mulk and the sūra al-Qalam bless with peace the guide, the banner,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome,
O You Who spared me the arduous affairs, bless with peace, by the right of al-Ḥāqqa,
the Prophet and Messenger Aḥmad, the Family and the Companions; and make my life praiseworthy.
O You Who lead me to the best ways out, bless the one possessed of the sūra al-Maʿārij,
our master Muḥammad, with peace, in the Family and the Companions; and spare me blame.
By the right of Nūḥ and by the right of al-Jinn, bless with peace the Possessor of favour,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome,
O One (Al-Wāḥid), O Eternal Refuge (Aṣ-Ṣamad), You are the Finder (Al-Wājid), Powerful (Al-Qādir), All-Powerful (Al-Muqtadir), You are the Glorious (Al-Mājid),
bless the Enwrapped (al-Muzzammil), the Cloaked (al-Muddaththir), by the sanctity of al-Muzzammil and al-Muddaththir,
and grant peace upon him, in the Family and his Companions, in the present, this and what fulfils (the outcome).
And spare us, before it makes (for us), blame, and evil deeds, Lord, and (evil) speech.
The blessing of our Lord, the Most High, the Bringer-Forward (Al-Muqaddim), with His peace, upon the one brought forward,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and the Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
O First (Al-Awwal), O Last (Al-Ākhir), O Delayer (Al-Muʾakhkhir), Your being for me without harm I store up,
bless with peace our master Muḥammad, our beloved, our guide,
his Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome, O You Who sustain the state.
O Manifest (Aẓ-Ẓāhir), O Hidden (Al-Bāṭin), bless forever and grant peace upon him whose grace has appeared,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and the Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
